## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain what fails today and what this change makes possible.

## Verification

List the checks actually run and their results. For native changes, include OS/architecture and Python/Go versions. Include an installed-wheel or sdist test for packaging changes.

## Compatibility and evidence

Describe any deliberate model-format/token-ID/API change. For performance claims, link repeatable measurements and identify the workload. Keep private data, trained checkpoints and raw corpora out of the diff.
